item.description: - Clearer when Claude rate-limits plan usage: a calm message with a countdown, and Dashbar now retries as soon as the wait ends

- **Plan limit alerts**: a notification when a Claude or Codex limit reaches 80%, when it's on course to run out before it resets, and when it's used up. Once per window - **Needs you**: when Claude stops to ask for permission or an answer, Dashbar shows it in amber, puts it first, counts it beside the menu bar icon and can notify you. A permission prompt no longer sends a false "finished" notification - **⌃⌥D** opens the Dashbar window from anywhere, and closes it again - Each new notification can be turned off in Settings - Claude plan limits cope with Claude's rate limiting: Dashbar waits before asking again and keeps showing the last reading, instead of an error - Superset is recognised among running agent apps, and card titles line up with their contents
- A new installer window: the download now opens with an arrow from Dashbar to Applications, so it is clear where to drag it
